mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') as month, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) as total FROM tb_order WHERE status >= 1 AND is_deleted = 0 AND YEAR(create_time) = #{year} GROUP BY month ORDER BY month ASC

SELECT c.name as name, SUM(oi.quantity) as value FROM tb_order_item oi JOIN tb_order o ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN tb_book b ON oi.book_id = b.id JOIN tb_category c ON b.category_id = c.id WHERE o.status >= 1 AND o.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM tb_order WHERE status >= 1 AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT DATE(create_time) as date, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) as amount FROM tb_order WHERE status >= 1 AND is_deleted = 0 AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT c.name as name, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) as value FROM tb_category c LEFT JOIN tb_book b ON b.category_id = c.id AND b.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN tb_order_item oi ON oi.book_id = b.id LEFT JOIN tb_order o ON oi.order_id = o.id AND o.status >= 1 AND o.is_deleted = 0 WHERE c.parent_id != 0 AND c.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT b.id as bookId, b.title as title, b.author as author, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) as totalSales, COALESCE(SUM(oi.price * oi.quantity), 0) as totalAmount FROM tb_book b LEFT JOIN tb_order_item oi ON oi.book_id = b.id LEFT JOIN tb_order o ON oi.order_id = o.id AND o.status >= 1 AND o.is_deleted = 0 WHERE b.is_deleted = 0 AND b.status = 1 GROUP BY b.id, b.title, b.author ORDER BY totalSales DESC LIMIT 10
